bio: Saducine carries dangerous powers: a mind-controlling hexdoll and an arsenal of curses. The world got lucky when she found a love of justice instead of coin… and that she found Sebastin, who could see the dreams of mortals and know their true desires. Together, they are the bane of all tyrants.
